rulesets.s: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. THREE-QUARTER FRONT, FULL BODY. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS, 3 columns by 2 rows, clear empty pure-magenta gaps, SAME character scale and camera, common baseline. No text, no labels, no borders. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF.

Cells L-R then top-bottom: walk left foot forward; walk right foot forward; walk stretch; dash start lean; dash mid-blur; dash recover. Poses MUST differ.
